query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int8 AS "sessions!", ROUND(AVG(avg_viewers)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS avg_viewers, ROUND(AVG(peak_viewers)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS peak_viewers, ROUND(AVG(unique_chatters)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS unique_chatters, ROUND(AVG(first_time_chatters)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS first_time_chatters, ROUND(AVG(returning_chatters)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS returning_chatters, ROUND(AVG(dropoff_pct)::numeric, 4)::float8 AS dropoff_pct, ROUND(AVG(follower_delta)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS follower_delta FROM ( SELECT avg_viewers, peak_viewers, unique_chatters, first_time_chatters, returning_chatters, dropoff_pct, CASE WHEN follower_delta IS NOT NULL AND NOT (followers_end = 0 AND followers_start > 0) THEN follower_delta ELSE NULL END AS follower_delta FROM twitch_stream_sessions WHERE LOWER(streamer_login) = LOWER($1) AND id <> $2 AND ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT 5 ) recent
